# NEO Bank

> Event-driven banking platform demo: register in minutes, check your balance
> in real time, and send money instantly with bank-grade security.

NEO Bank is a full-stack banking application built as event-driven
microservices — an API gateway in front of Auth, Account, Transfer (saga
orchestrator), and Transaction services, each owning its own Cassandra
keyspace, with Kafka for asynchronous events, Docker Compose for local
topology, and Kubernetes/Terraform for cloud deployment.
